story: Stage 5 of the Tour of Magnificent Qinghai 2026 was marked by brutal weather conditions, including freezing temperatures and ice-cold rain throughout the race. XDS fractured the peloton on the climb, prompting an attack from Mulubrhan. He was soon joined by teammate Van Bekkum, but their breakaway was reeled in by a chasing group led by Castellon. Immediately after the groups merged, Bagatin launched a decisive attack, quickly building a significant gap. On a subsequent downhill, Caicedo surged ahead from the pursuit group, finishing second in the stage behind Bagatin and claiming the yellow jersey.
